summary: Small rectangular black motor-controller PCB with a micro-USB connector on one edge, a row of through-hole header pads along the left edge and bottom edge, four large power-terminal pads on the right edge, and two tall cylindrical capacitors on top.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the PCB, which carries the bottom-side components. It would rest on standoffs at the mounting holes.

notes: The printed drawing shows 1.4 in x 1.2 in, so x = 35.56 mm and y = 30.48 mm. This overrides the unverified listing value of 1.0 in x 1.2 in. No height is printed. The z value of 8 mm is a rough estimate covering the PCB and the tall capacitors. Hole positions and the 2.2 mm diameter were scaled from the top-view image, with the origin at the board center and +y toward the USB edge. Some corner holes may be missing or imprecise. Header pads, terminal pads and the USB connector were not modeled as separate holes.
